name: computer-use
title: Computer Use
description: Let a chat's bots see and use apps and the browser on this server's computer, through cua-driver.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: List the desktop and browser tools Computer Use offers, with cua-driver's guide to using them, or pass a tool's name for its full description and arguments. Read a tool's arguments here before its first call.

tool.description: A tool's name, such as get_window_state. Omit to list every tool.

tools.name: call
tools.description: Run one cua-driver tool on this computer's desktop or browser. Common ones: list_windows, launch_app, get_window_state (accessibility tree and screenshot), run_steps (act and observe in one call), click, type_text, press_key, hotkey, scroll, get_browser_state, browser_navigate, browser_click, browser_type. Screenshots come back as images. Acting happens in the background without taking focus unless a tool says otherwise.

args.description: Its arguments, as describe lists them.
